<\STATESEP>chapter "Decoding System Calls"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>theory Decode_SA
imports    "Ipc_SA"

begin<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>section "IRQ"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>section "Toplevel invocation decode."<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>definition
  decode_invocation ::
  "data \<Rightarrow> data list \<Rightarrow> cap_ref \<Rightarrow> cslot_ptr \<Rightarrow> cap \<Rightarrow> (cap \<times> cslot_ptr) list \<Rightarrow> (invocation,'z::state_ext) se_monad"
where
  "decode_invocation label args cap_index slot cap excaps \<equiv>
  case cap of
    NotificationCap ptr badge rights \<Rightarrow>
      if AllowSend \<in> rights then
        returnOk $ InvokeNotification ptr badge
      else throwError $ InvalidCapability 0
  | _ \<Rightarrow>
      throwError $ InvalidCapability 0"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>end<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP>
